presentation.label: SINGLE-HEAD ECHO
presentation.summary: A single-head echo with wow, flutter and tape age.
presentation.overview: A single-head tape echo with wow, randomized flutter and tape age. Explore drifting repeats, worn tape texture and feedback, with free or beat-synced timing.
usage: Choose TAPE ECHO in FX2. SYNC selects FREE timing or BEAT divisions; TIME adjusts the delay.

FDBK controls repeats, WOW adds pitch movement and flutter, and AGE changes bandwidth and tape noise. MIX sets the balance: up to 64 the echo rises to full level over the whole dry signal, then the dry fades out to the echo alone at 127.
When migrating older projects, former HEADS locks now address AGE. Back up projects and review old effect defaults and parameter locks.

controls.name: TIME
controls.doc: FREE: 46..231 ms; BEAT: twelve note divisions from 1/64 to dotted 1/4

controls.name: FDBK
controls.doc: repeat intensity; the upper range safely self-oscillates from tape noise

controls.name: WOW
controls.doc: 0.8 Hz wow plus irregular flutter; about 8 cents at 44, 22 cents at 127

controls.name: AGE
controls.doc: repeat bandwidth, flutter and noise; fresh at 0, worn at 127

controls.name: SYNC
controls.doc: FREE uses milliseconds; BEAT quantises TIME from stock tempo

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: 0 is exact dry; up to 64 the echo rises to full level over the whole dry signal, then the dry fades out, leaving the echo alone at 127

limitations: The pinned hardware record reports six instances running and a seventh freezing the unit; that limit remains open. Recorded gates cover native arithmetic parity, dirty state, eight-instance stress, moving controls and repeat/feedback behavior. Hardware timing and worst-case CPU headroom remain unqualified.

storage.label: CPU state / shared arena
storage.conditions: 1,600 bytes for eight tracks. Uses the shared 10 MiB DRAM platform reservation and existing stock delay rings; these are not additive per module. No DSP delay buffer.

processing.label: CPU instruction peak
processing.conditions: Eight instances with all controls reversing in BEAT mode. FREE peaked at 19,087. 0.1.6 adds 1,024 to both while MIX, FDBK or AGE is moving. These emulator instruction counts are not hardware cycles or CPU percentages.

impact.conditions: Audio modules are rated for an active instance, including expensive modes and changing controls; MIDI/USB features are rated while enabled. More tracks or instances increase demand. Shared runtime reservations and reused stock buffers are not added again per module. These rough source-backed tiers do not establish hardware headroom or qualification.

cpu.rationale: Tape Echo processes audio continuously on ColdFire. Eight modulated instances peak at 22,571 emulator instructions per frame in BEAT mode, versus 7,628 for eight stock DELAY instances in the same record. High is a relative work estimate, not a CPU percentage.

dsp.rationale: The DSP side is the documented empty passthrough with one NOP per sample and no tape delay buffer. This indicates minimal added DSP demand while CPU processing carries the effect.

memory.rationale: The module adds 200 bytes of state per track plus code and coefficient tables, while reusing stock delay rings. The common 10 MiB DRAM platform arena is shared rather than additive per instance. Moderate is an incremental footprint estimate.

tests.summary: 0.1.6 follows BBD's MIX law so turning Tape Echo on no longer turns the track down (issue #969): up to MIX 64 the echo rises over the whole dry signal, above it the dry fades out; the default is MIX 40. The ColdFire kernels match their native oracle bit for bit on the emulator; the echo path, feedback law and self-oscillation headroom are unchanged. The pinned hardware record reports six instances running and a seventh freezing the unit; that limit remains open, and no hardware run, chip timing or listening test exists for 0.1.6. See TESTING.md.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: Tape Echo in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to Tape Echo and press YES to assign it.
Press FX2 to close SETUP, then adjust TIME, FDBK, WOW, AGE, SYNC and MIX. All six active controls are on this main page.
